an3.124:1.1: Yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti manasikātum pi me esā bhikkhave disā na phāsu hoti, pageva gantuṃ.
an3.124:1.3: addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu tayo dhamme bahulī-m-akaṃsu.
an3.124:1.10: Yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti manasikātuṃ pi me esā bhikkhave disā na phāsu hoti, pageva gantuṃ.
an3.124:1.12: addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu ime tayo dhamme bahulī-m-akaṃsu.
an3.124:2.1: Yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññam piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti gantum pi me esā bhikkhave disā phāsu hoti, pageva manasikātuṃ.
an3.124:2.3: addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu ime tayo dhamme bahulī-m-akaṃsu.
an3.124:2.10: Yassaṃ bhikkhave disāyaṃ bhikkhū samaggā . . . viharanti gantum pi me esā bhikkhave disā phāsu hoti, pageva manasikātuṃ.
